abilities.name: Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma
abilities.caveat: Solar Isotoma's Transient Blossoms — the on-hit Geo damage that constitutes most of Albedo's output — are not rendered on the timeline. The 30s active window only shows the construct's lifetime; emission timing and DEF-scaled damage are not modelled.
_curatorNotes: Solar Isotoma is a Geo construct that emits Transient Blossoms (DEF-scaling Geo damage, 2s ICD) when an enemy inside its area takes damage. Blossom emission is NOT a summonTick (P3 v1) — it's an onHit-from-summon trigger gated by player damage events landing within the Isotoma area. P3 v1 only covers periodic ticks; the onHit-while-summon-active primitive is a separate future extension.
Recasting E spawns a fresh Solar Isotoma and replaces the prior one (gcsim Constructs.New replace=true) — captured as terminatesOn: "recast".
Construct also acts as a climbable platform / blocker; not relevant for the planner.
abilities.description:
Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma using alchemy, which deals AoE Geo DMG on appearance.

Solar Isotoma
has the following properties:
·When opponents within the Solar Isotoma field take DMG, the Solar Isotoma will generate Transient Blossoms which deal AoE Geo DMG. DMG dealt scales off Albedo's DEF. 
·Transient Blossoms can only be generated once every 2s.
·When a character is located at the locus of the Solar Isotoma, the Solar Isotoma will accumulate Geo power to form a crystallized platform that lifts the character up to a certain height. Only one crystallized platform can exist at a time.
·Solar Isotoma is considered a Geo construct. Only one Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself can exist at a time. 

Hold to designate the location of the skill.

abilities.name: Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide
_curatorNotes: Burst fires in two phases: Tectonic Tide initial hit at frame 75, then up to 7 Fatal Blossoms starting at frame 145 (each 5 frames apart) — but only if Solar Isotoma is active. Both phases happen inside the cast animation so we author as instant; per-blossom timing is not separately rendered.

Cancel frames (swap 93 / D 95 / J 94) reflect the full burst animation, not the initial hit at 75. Albedo can be swapped earlier in practice via the construct's queueing — gcsim's CanQueueAfter is burstFrames[ActionSwap]=93, treating that as the canonical animation length.
abilities.description:
Under Albedo's command, Geo crystals surge and burst forth, dealing AoE Geo DMG in front of him.
If a Solar Isotoma created by Albedo himself is on the field, 7 Fatal Blossoms will be generated in the Solar Isotoma field, bursting violently into bloom and dealing AoE Geo DMG.

Tectonic Tide DMG and Fatal Blossom DMG will not generate Transient Blossoms.

constellations.name: Opening of Phanerozoic
_curatorNotes: Fatal Reckoning: Transient Blossoms grant up to 4 stacks (30s); Q consumes all stacks, each adding 30% DEF flat damage to Fatal Blossom + Tectonic Tide DMG. Not modelled — depends on blossom emission (P3) and stack-count gating (deferred). Removed the prior placeholder damage effect that was modelling a single stack incorrectly.
constellations.description:
Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma grant Albedo Fatal Reckoning for 30s:
·Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes all stacks of Fatal Reckoning. Each stack of Fatal Reckoning consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms and Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide's burst DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF.
·This effect stacks up to 4 times.
